reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, and I like that, plus the sachets would be easy to toss in my travel pill case. But it is $1 a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood cost $0.20-0.40, and there are zero reviews, so I would not pay that much for an unknown brand.
objection: A dollar a serving for a brand with no reviews. I would be paying a travel-convenience premium on something I cannot check against anyone else's experience, and I can already count capsules into a zip bag myself.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen real reviews that mention the lab report actually matching, and a price closer to $18-20 for the 30 count, or a trial size I could test on one trip.
